messages:
lia (design): quick heads-up from the design review — a few UX nits for the routing policies editor preview we should triage. main items: priority ordering visibility, validation message clarity, and the simulation preview's collapse behaviour on small widths. looping in @ravi @noah
ravi (pm): thanks. can you list repro + recommended copy so we can scope?
lia (design): repro: open a policy > Rules > enable Preview Simulation > add 6 rules > shrink viewport to 420px > reorder 2x > run sim. issues: 1) the rule order numbers disappear under certain widths, 2) validation callouts read as "error" with no context, 3) the preview panel auto-collapses and hides the sim summary unexpectedly.	
noah (frontend): hmm. order numbers are using a fixed 36px gutter and we clamp the label at 3 chars -> when title wraps it pushes the number off-screen. I can make numbers sticky in the left column and collapse long rule names earlier.
tess (eng): about collapse — we auto-collapse the preview when vertical space < 300px; that's aggressive. we can change to a min-height clamp and prefer scroll inside the preview instead of collapsing.
lia (design): copy recs for validation badges: current: "Conflict detected" (hover only). proposed short string on card: "Priority conflict — unreachable" and SR-friendly aria-label: "Priority conflict, rule unreachable". also add a tooltip with detail: "This rule cannot match because a higher-priority rule matches the same traffic."
a11y-bot: automated scan: failures: 1) badge text contrast ratio 2.9:1 small text (needs 4.5:1), 2) validation only exposed via hover (not keyboard accessible), 3) reorder control missing role=button and aria-grabbed semantics.
ravi (pm): for the small-copy variant can we try two options for the badge: A) "Conflict — unreachable" B) "Skipped: priority". which reads better aloud?
tess (eng): I'd vote A. shorter and the word "skipped" can be ambiguous for users. also recommend the summary phrasing after sim: "Simulation finished — 14 matched, 2 fallback, 0 errors" so it's concise but structured.
noah (frontend): technical plan: 1) promote the ordinal number to its own column (sticky), 2) render badge text inline with `aria-describedby` pointing to a visually-hidden detail (for keyboard users), 3) make the preview summary a persistent bar with `role=status` so SR announces it. small screens: change collapse threshold to 220px and prefer internal scrolling.
lia (design): UI tweak: make the reorder handle first focus target inside the card (tabindex=0), add `aria-label="Reorder rule"` and `aria-pressed` state during drag. also show a micro-anim during drag so users see the placeholder position.
a11y-bot: recommended fixes list: increase contrast to meet AA, ensure hover-only info is also focusable (use button with aria-describedby), add role=button + aria-grabbed for drag handle, keep live region mounted between updates.
ravi (pm): I'll open tickets: INF-3610 sticky-ordinals-and-layout, INF-3611 validation-accessibility-copy, INF-3612 preview-collapse-behaviour. target sprint: next week. assign owners: noah -> INF-3610, tess -> INF-3612, lia -> INF-3611 for copy.
lia (design): one last ask — in the preview simulation add a compact "how it reads" toggle that surfaces the last SR announcement text inline and allows toggling between short/verbose modes. this helps writers validate copy without running assistive tech.
noah (frontend): can add a non-voice preview text box first (low effort) and we can hook up TTS afterwards. I'll prototype it in INF-3610.
tess (eng): sounds good. i'll make sure the status bar is tabbable and emits polite live updates.
ravi (pm): awesome. let's keep changes small and test with NVDA + VoiceOver once merged. thanks team :rocket:
